items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yes Joe, I've met him. Joe Renee. [INTERVIEWEE] Joe Renee was the drummer.

ctx.x: Oh Zarder. Chester Zarder. That was the bass player. Oh yes I know him too. And you had Renee and you had Morris and you had my daddy and you had the drummer. The drummer was Renee's brother.
Oh yes Joe, I've met him. Joe Renee.
